category.name: Lists
category.preferred_workflow: Create a List via doc.Lists.Add(ListTemplate), assign it to builder.ListFormat.List, set builder.ListFormat.ListLevelNumber for each nesting level, write the paragraph text, and finally call builder.ListFormat.RemoveNumbers() to terminate the list before adding non-list content.

strict_api_bans: Do not reference APIs that are not present in Aspose.Words, such as ListFormat.IncreaseIndent, DecreaseIndent, List.Clone, or ListNumberStyle.
Do not omit the assignment of builder.ListFormat.List before writing list items.
canonical_patterns: Create a list with doc.Lists.Add(ListTemplate) and configure its ListLevel properties (NumberStyle, NumberFormat, Alignment, StartAt, NumberPosition, TextPosition).
Apply the list to the builder by setting builder.ListFormat.List, then control nesting with builder.ListFormat.ListLevelNumber.
Terminate the list with builder.ListFormat.RemoveNumbers() to prevent unintended list formatting on subsequent paragraphs.
nullable_warning_prevention: Guard against null List references before accessing ListLevel properties.
Validate that a Paragraph's ListFormat.IsListItem is true before reading list-specific attributes.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS1061 because members such as IncreaseIndent, DecreaseIndent, Indentation, StartingNumber, BulletChar, or List.Clone are not found.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code references API members that were removed or never existed in the Aspose.Words 26.11.0 library.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the missing members with supported alternatives: control nesting via builder.ListFormat.ListLevelNumber and adjust positioning with ListLevel.NumberPosition and TextPosition; use ListLevel.StartAt to set the start number.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official Aspose.Words API reference and limit code to members that appear in the current version's documentation.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS0103 or CS0234 when using ListNumberStyle, NumberStyle.Decimal, or ListLevel.StartingNumber, which are undefined.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code uses outdated or misspelled identifiers; the correct enum is NumberStyle and the correct start-number property is ListLevel.StartAt.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace ListNumberStyle with NumberStyle, use NumberStyle.Arabic, UppercaseRoman, Bullet, etc., and set ListLevel.StartAt instead of StartingNumber.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Reference the latest enum definitions and property names from the Aspose.Words.Lists namespace.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS1061 because Document, CompatibilityOptions, or OoxmlSaveOptions do not expose an OoxmlCompliance member.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The OoxmlCompliance property is not part of the Aspose.Words 26.11.0 API surface.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Remove any attempts to set OoxmlCompliance; rely on the default compliance level or configure compatibility via Document.CompatibilityOptions if needed.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Verify property availability in the target Aspose.Words version before using it in code.

examples.task: Create a default numbered list in a Word document using DocumentBuilder.ListFormat.ApplyNumberDefault method.
Apply a default bulleted list to paragraphs with DocumentBuilder.ListFormat.ApplyBulletDefault method for formatting.
Set ListLevelNumber to three before adding a paragraph to create a third-level list item in the document.
Increase list indent programmatically using DocumentBuilder.ListFormat.IncreaseIndent to move paragraph deeper within the current list structure.
Decrease list indent with DocumentBuilder.ListFormat.DecreaseIndent to promote paragraph to higher level in the outline.
Remove numbering from a paragraph by calling DocumentBuilder.ListFormat.RemoveNumbers method to stop list formatting.
Create a custom List object, configure its levels, and add it to Document.Lists collection.
Add a new List to the document's ListCollection and assign it to multiple paragraphs to share formatting.
Assign an existing List to a paragraph by setting Paragraph.ListFormat.List property to apply the desired list style.
Clone an existing List, modify its level start values, and apply the cloned list to new sections.
Set NumberStyle of a ListLevel to UpperRoman to generate Roman numeral list items.
Apply a custom bullet character to a list by setting ListLevel.NumberStyle to Bullet and defining BulletChar.
Define StartingNumber for a ListLevel to begin numbering at five instead of default one.
Restart numbering for each new section by resetting ListLevel.StartingNumber before applying the list.
Create a numbered list that restarts numbering at each new chapter by resetting StartingNumber on chapter start.
Create a nine-level hierarchical list by defining properties for each ListLevel up to level nine.
Create a multi-level list with alternating bullet and number styles by configuring each ListLevel individually.
Adjust ListLevel indentation by setting ListLevel.Indentation to 36 points for proper alignment.
Apply a custom tab stop to list levels to align text after numbers using ListLevel.TabPosition property.
Configure TabPosition of a ListLevel to 72 points to align text after list number.
Validate that each list in a document does not exceed nine levels to comply with API constraints.
Implement error handling for attempts to create more than nine list levels, catching the resulting exception.
Ensure OoxmlCompliance is set higher than Ecma376 before saving document to retain custom list settings.
Check document OoxmlCompliance property and set to higher than Ecma376 when modifying list definitions.
Retrieve a specific List from Document.Lists by its ID and adjust its level properties programmatically.
Iterate through Document.Lists collection to modify all list definitions uniformly across the document.
Apply a uniform list style to all lists by iterating over Document.Lists and updating each level.
Programmatically increase list level depth for a paragraph using DocumentBuilder.ListFormat.IncreaseIndent within a loop.
Programmatically decrease list level depth for a paragraph using DocumentBuilder.ListFormat.DecreaseIndent inside a conditional.
Programmatically remove list formatting from selected paragraphs while preserving their indentation using ListFormat.RemoveNumbers.

narrative.overview: The Lists category covers creation, configuration, and manipulation of Word list structures using Aspose.Words. Verified examples demonstrate correct usage of List, ListLevel, and DocumentBuilder.ListFormat APIs for numbered, bulleted, nested, and custom lists.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding assistant with clear guidance on how to generate and modify Word lists reliably, ensuring that only supported Aspose.Words APIs are used and that list formatting is applied and cleared correctly.
validation_priorities: Ensure that every list sequence sets builder.ListFormat.List, adjusts ListLevelNumber as needed, and calls RemoveNumbers() when the list ends.
maintenance_notes: Periodically review the Aspose.Words release notes to update the list of supported APIs and adjust the canonical patterns accordingly.
